answers.core: This improves engine usability drastically for everyone who ever uses 3d models in Godot. I have seen many complaints about the inability to batch assign materials to meshes online. It's huge for out of the box usability.
answers.workaround: This is such a basic functionality that any plugin for this adds unnecessary work and complicates things.

title: Add an import setting to assign an external material to an imported mesh by default like in Godot 3
